rationale: Model 0.4608 below base; Rs 12 dividend goes ex on 14 October inside the window (filing nse-ann-106811188); Q2 results mixed (small EPS beat, margin miss). Final P(up) 0.42.
lesson: Down call at 0.58 confidence, 5 days, missed: TCS returned 18.2%, closing 2465, about 14% above the 80% band top. A Rs 12 dividend and mixed results were swamped by a sector-wide IT rally; intraday deviations on day one held by the close and foreshadowed the miss. Weak model edge plus small dividend was not enough; one call proves little.
